The system implementation is thoroughly documented, experimental baselines use controlled environments and identical backbones, and the headline metrics are backed by official benchmark judges as well as independent blinded evaluations.

evidence.excerpt:
Autonomous research agents can generate hypotheses, exe-
cute experiments, and draft manuscripts, yet their outputs of-
ten contain unsupported claims and inconsistencies between
researchquestions,experiments,results,andconclusions.We
arguethatthisproblemispartlyarchitectural:existingsystems
organize research as sequential pipelines but do not explic-
itly maintain or validate the evolving claim–evidence struc-
ture across stages. In this paper, we introduceEviGraph,
an autonomous research framework that represents the re-
searchprocessasatypedevidencegraphcontainingProblem,
Gap,Hypothesis,Experiment,Finding,andClaimnodes.The
graphservesastheoperationalstateoftheagentratherthana
post-hoc record. EviGraph inspects evidence chains for miss-
ing dependencies, semantic misalignment, and result–claim
inconsistencies, localizes the earliest weak node, and regen-
erates its affected downstream

evidence.excerpt:
State
EviGraph represents the evolving research state as a typed
directed graph. After initialization, it is the shared state of
all graph-facing components and the object inspected to de-
termine whether research should continue. Unlike a linear
pipeline trace, the graph can branch and merge (e.g., one
hypothesismaybeevaluatedbymultipleexperiments,while
several findings may jointly support or qualify a claim).
Research graph.An EviGraph research graph is a tuple
G= (V, E, τ, ρ, α), whereVis a set of research-object
nodes,E⊆V×Vis a set of directed edges,τ:V→ T
assigns a type to each node,ρ:E→ Rassigns a relation
type to each edge, andα:V→ Astores type-specific
node attributes, whereAdenotes the space of structured
attribute records. For example, anExperimentnode records
the datasets, implementation code, and evaluation metrics

C←AnalyzeTask(q)
L←RetrieveLiterature(C)
R←RetrieveExperience(q,M L)
H ←GenerateHypotheses(C, L)
D ←GroupDirections(H)
P←RunPilotExperiments(D)
H⋆ ←SelectBestSupported(D, P)
X←FullScaleEvaluate(H ⋆)
G←BuildInitialGraph(C, L,H ⋆, X, R)
{Inspect and repair with checkpoints}
MS ← ⟨G⟩;T ← ⟨⟩
(s,W)←InspectGraph(G, B)
whiles=RepairableandbudgetBremainsdo
Sw ←SelectRepairGroup(W)
Gbase ←G
Aw ←PlanRepair(G base, Sw, R)
(Gcand,M S , B,complete)←ExecuteRepairGroup(A w,M S , B)
ifcompletethen
d←Degrading(G cand, Gbase)
if¬dthen
G←G cand
else
G←RollbackToBest(M S , Gbase)
end if
else
G←RollbackToBest(M S , Gbase)
end if
ifWeakCount(G)<WeakCount(G base)then
T ←Append(T,(G base, Sw,A w, G))
end if
(s,W)←InspectGraph(G, B)
end

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline gains are measured by external benchmark harnesses and blinded CSR/EDC pipelines that do not accept native graph annotations as evidence.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: ARC-Bench-ML uses two independent agent reviewers with re-adjudication, NanoResearch-20 uses its official harness, and CSR/EDC use blinded extractors and membership judges over normalized run records.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The internal loop is shaped by the Graph Inspector, deterministic relation checks, and Paper Reviewer, which localize weak nodes and gate drafting.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Main empirical claims are well supported by the evaluation results: EviGraph outperforms baselines on ARC-Bench-ML Overall score (86.45% vs 60.37%) and achieves superior Claim Support Rate (37.85% vs 27%), while maintaining 87.73% data consistency [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0032, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0034]. The paper transparently reports that NanoResearch achieves higher Alignment and EDC [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0032, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0033].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation is conducted across two established multi-task benchmarks (ARC-Bench-ML with 25 tasks and NanoResearch-20 with 20 tasks) using a shared LLM backbone (qwen-3.6-plus) and uniform sandbox execution environments [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0028, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0029, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0151]. In addition to official benchmark evaluation protocols, reliability is assessed via blinded extraction of Claim Support Rate (CSR) and Experimental Data Consistency (EDC) [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0030, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0152, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0162].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance and reliability gains are corroborated by independent benchmark harnesses and blinded evaluation extractors that do not accept native graph annotations as evidence [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0029, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0162, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0164].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: The reported outcomes are evaluated using external benchmark suites (ARC-Bench-ML independent dual-agent strict reviewers and NanoResearch-20 official harness) and separate blinded post-hoc evaluation pipelines for CSR and EDC [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0029, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0030, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0149, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0162].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The iterative research loop is guided internally by the Graph Inspector, Paper Reviewer, and deterministic relation checks that localize weak nodes and gate manuscript drafting [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0022, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0024, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0148].

primary.limitations: The authors explicitly note that the tight component coupling precludes traditional single-component ablations and that the case trace did not trigger rollback or cross-run retrieval [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0036, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0167]. Limitations in task alignment compared to specialized baselines are acknowledged [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0032].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is comprehensively specified, detailing graph schema definitions, formal degradation and rollback rules, orchestrator and sandbox interfaces, and operational LLM prompt contracts across all phases [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0018, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0024, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0059, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0140]. The architecture addresses pipeline drift by explicitly modeling downstream invalidations when upstream nodes are regenerated [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0022].
primary.quality_rationale: The work makes a clear, well-scoped architectural and empirical contribution to autonomous scientific agents. The system implementation is thoroughly documented, experimental baselines use controlled environments and identical backbones, and the headline metrics are backed by official benchmark judges as well as independent blinded evaluations.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper presents EviGraph, an autonomous research framework that maintains an operational typed evidence graph (Problem, Gap, Hypothesis, Experiment, Finding, Claim) to inspect evidence chains, localize weak nodes, execute dependency-aware repairs, and gate manuscript drafting on validated evidence chains [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0002, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0006, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0015].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The work makes a clear, well-scoped architectural and empirical contribution to autonomous scientific agents. The system implementation is thoroughly documented, experimental baselines use controlled environments and identical backbones, and the headline metrics are backed by official benchmark judges as well as independent blinded evaluations.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors explicitly note that the tight component coupling precludes traditional single-component ablations and that the case trace did not trigger rollback or cross-run retrieval [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0036, Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0167]. Limitations in task alignment compared to specialized baselines are acknowledged [Eca2141e53543d7d6-B0032].

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
